name: xdBot Companion
description: Independent Android macro picker with multi-file share sheet, accessible from xdBot's load-macro UI; no xdBot binary included.

share-after-save.name: Offer to share saved macros
share-after-save.description: After a new xdBot macro file finishes saving, ask whether to open Android's share sheet. Nothing is uploaded automatically.

monitor-start.name: Show minimal monitor at level start
monitor-start.description: Display a small FPS, deaths and last-death overlay; can also be toggled in the pause menu.
